Claude and Codex engine icons

Source: https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons
Revision: 8a1b2821bb768c484fe8da20c5e1838b6bf551a9
Files: packages/static-svg/icons/claude.svg and codex.svg
Adaptation: original path geometry packaged as SVG symbols.

claude-working.svg uses the same MIT-licensed Claude path in nine cells with
an added center hub. This is an independently reconstructed bloom/contraction
animation, not an extracted Anthropic animation asset. Its nine 90ms steps
follow the classic spark reference shared in:
https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/99139

claude-working-alternating.svg combines that flower geometry with six geometric
vector marks, avoiding platform-font and emoji substitution. It uses a 450ms
entry contraction, then alternates a 2000ms six-mark round trip with an 810ms
flower cycle. The original claude-working.svg still owns the completed mark's
click replay. This combined working sequence is cc-remote's presentation,
not an extracted Claude Desktop animation.

Claude and its marks belong to Anthropic. Codex and its marks belong to OpenAI.
These icons identify the selected third-party engine, not cc-remote itself.
No affiliation or endorsement is implied. The MIT license below covers the
icon-library code; it does not grant trademark rights.
OpenAI brand guidelines: https://openai.com/brand/
